newsitem.title: USA: Ronson says 66 pct preferred shrs tendered.
newsitem.headline: Ronson says 66 pct preferred shrs tendered.

text.p: Ronson Corp said on Wednesday that 66 percent of its 12 percent cumulative convertible preferred stock have been tendered under its exchange offer.
A total of 556,374 shares of the outstanding stock, have been tendered for exchange, it said.
Ronson said a reduction in the number of outstanding preferred shares could hurt its liquidity and the market value of the remaining shares.
The preferred stock might also not meet NASDAQ requirements for listing on the SmallCap market and might no longer continue to be registered under the Exchange Act, it said.
The company said the offer provided for the issuance of 1.7 shares of common stock for each share of preferred stock.
The offer would be open until January 21, unless extended, it said.
